title: GSM MAP: fix Version 2 of ResetArg
description:
Trying to fix GSM MAP ResetArg v2. The previous MR is https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/4072

From [3GPP TS 29.002 version 10.11.0 Release 10](https://www.etsi.org/deliver/etsi_ts/129000_129099/129002/10.11.00_60/ts_129002v101100p.pdf) at page 294 and page 386, seems like it is the final specification for ResetArg v2. The earlier specification could find from [3G TS 29.002 version 3.3.0 Release 1999](https://www.etsi.org/deliver/etsi_ts/129000_129099/129002/03.03.00_60/ts_129002v030300p.pdf) at page 261 and page 337.
